description:
Pit of My Dreams: Reinterpretations II is the second portion of a two-part remix collection featuring reworks by producer TEK.LUN and producer Suzi Analogue. 

Multimedia artist Kevin Chambers used A.I. (VQGAN+CLIP) to create custom cover art, using the original Pit of My Dreams cover art (painted by visual artist Taryn Harris) as the base. 

Over the course of three days, the algorithm created a "remix" of the original piece by compiling 1000’s of images of erupting volcanoes. The resulting digital painting represents a state of release/catharsis.
